schema_ddl:
CREATE TABLE event
(
    event_id   TEXT
        constraint event_pk
            primary key,
    event_name TEXT,
    event_date TEXT,
    type       TEXT,
    notes      TEXT,
    location   TEXT,
    status     TEXT
);

CREATE TABLE major
(
    major_id   TEXT
        constraint major_pk
            primary key,
    major_name TEXT,
    department TEXT,
    college    TEXT
);

CREATE TABLE zip_code
(
    zip_code    INTEGER
        constraint zip_code_pk
            primary key,
    type        TEXT,
    city        TEXT,
    county      TEXT,
    state       TEXT,
    short_state TEXT
);

CREATE TABLE "attendance"
(
    link_to_event  TEXT,
    link_to_member TEXT,
    primary key (link_to_event, link_to_member),
    foreign key (link_to_event) references event(event_id),
    foreign key (link_to_member) references member(member_id)
);

CREATE TABLE "budget"
(
    budget_id     TEXT
            primary key,
    category      TEXT,
    spent         REAL,
    remaining     REAL,
    amount        INTEGER,
    event_status  TEXT,
    link_to_event TEXT,
    foreign key (link_to_event) references event(event_id)
);

CREATE TABLE "expense"
(
    expense_id          TEXT
            primary key,
    expense_description TEXT,
    expense_date        TEXT,
    cost                REAL,
    approved            TEXT,
    link_to_member      TEXT,
    link_to_budget      TEXT,
    foreign key (link_to_budget) references budget(budget_id),
    foreign key (link_to_member) references member(member_id)
);

CREATE TABLE "income"
(
    income_id      TEXT
        constraint income_pk
            primary key,
    date_received  TEXT,
    amount         INTEGER,
    source         TEXT,
    notes          TEXT,
    link_to_member TEXT,
    foreign key (link_to_member) references member(member_id)
);

CREATE TABLE "member"
(
    member_id     TEXT
        constraint member_pk
            primary key,
    first_name    TEXT,
    last_name     TEXT,
    email         TEXT,
    position      TEXT,
    t_shirt_size  TEXT,
    phone         TEXT,
    zip           INTEGER,
    link_to_major TEXT,
    foreign key (link_to_major) references major(major_id),
    foreign key (zip) references zip_code(zip_code)
);
q1: SELECT DISTINCT T1.first_name, T1.last_name, T2.major_name FROM member AS T1 INNER JOIN major AS T2 ON T2.major_id = T1.link_to_major INNER JOIN expense AS T3 ON T1.member_id = T3.link_to_member WHERE T3.cost > 100
q2: SELECT T2.first_name, T2.last_name, T3.major_name FROM expense AS T1 INNER JOIN member AS T2 ON T1.link_to_member = T2.member_id INNER JOIN major AS T3 ON T2.link_to_major = T3.major_id WHERE T1.cost > 100
q1_prompt_sql: SELECT DISTINCT T1.first_name, T1.last_name, T2.major_name FROM member AS T1 INNER JOIN major AS T2 ON T2.major_id = T1.link_to_major INNER JOIN expense AS T3 ON T1.member_id = T3.link_to_member WHERE T3.cost > 100
q2_prompt_sql: SELECT T2.first_name, T2.last_name, T3.major_name FROM expense AS T1 INNER JOIN member AS T2 ON T1.link_to_member = T2.member_id INNER JOIN major AS T3 ON T2.link_to_major = T3.major_id WHERE T1.cost > 100
counterexample: INSERT INTO major (major_id, major_name) VALUES ('M001', 'Computer Science'); INSERT INTO member (member_id, first_name, last_name, link_to_major) VALUES ('M001', 'John', 'Doe', 'M001'), ('M002', 'Jane', 'Smith', NULL); INSERT INTO expense (expense_id, cost, link_to_member) VALUES ('E001', 150, 'M001'), ('E002', 200, 'M002');
explanation: Q1 and Q2 are not semantically equivalent because they join the 'expense' table with the 'member' table and 'major' table in different orders. Q1 first joins 'expense' with 'member' and then with 'major', while Q2 first joins 'expense' with 'major' and then with 'member'. This difference in join order can lead to different results, especially if there are NULL values in the join conditions.
counterexample_dsp: The test data should include an expense record that is associated with a member who has a NULL value in the 'link_to_major' column. This will cause Q1 to exclude this record from the results, while Q2 will include it.
